records.context: Hosts pass their widget-to-image mapping to :meth:`handle` and inverse mapping to :meth:`paint`. Zoom and pan never change the measured length. Pixel units are always shown. Physical units require explicit, validated calibration through :meth:`set_spacing`; camera magnification is never guessed. Right-click clears while the tool is active. Start with no line, no calibration and drawing disabled.

Start with no line, no calibration and drawing disabled.
records.translation: Hýslar senda vörpun úr hnitum viðmótshlutar í myndhnit til :meth:`handle` og andhverfu vörpunina til :meth:`paint`. Aðdráttur og hliðrun breyta aldrei mældri lengd. Myndpunktaeiningar eru alltaf sýndar. Eðlisfræðilegar einingar krefjast skýrrar, staðfestrar kvörðunar með :meth:`set_spacing`; stækkun myndavélar er aldrei áætluð. Hægrismellur hreinsar línuna meðan verkfærið er virkt. Byrjar án línu og kvörðunar og með teikningu óvirka.

records.context: The ten tools, in :data:`TOOL_MODES` order, because this vocabulary is what a reader needs before opening the application view:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#2
records.source: THE TEN TOOLS, in :data:`TOOL_MODES` order, because this vocabulary is what a reader needs before opening the screen:
records.translation: VERKFÆRIN TÍU, í röðinni í :data:`TOOL_MODES`, því lesandinn þarf þennan orðaforða áður en skjárinn er opnaður:

records.context: **Ruler** is the tenth. Drag between image pixels to read a length without editing labels. Zoom and pan preserve it; right-click with Ruler selected clears it. The same ruler is available on the paired live preview canvases.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#5
records.source: **Ruler** is the tenth. Drag between image pixels to read a length without editing labels. Zoom and pan preserve it; right-click with Ruler selected clears it. The same ruler is available on the paired live preview canvases.
records.translation: **Reglustika** er tíunda verkfærið. Dragðu milli myndpunkta til að lesa lengd án þess að breyta merkingum. Aðdráttur og hliðrun varðveita mælinguna; hægrismellur með Reglustiku valda hreinsar hana. Sama reglustika er tiltæk á báðum myndflötum lifandi forskoðunar.

records.context: Editor modes are assembled from :func:`tool_row_entries` and :data:`TOOL_MODES`. :meth:`MakeMasksScreen.add_toolbar_action` inserts non-mode actions into the same toolbar. The settings panel carries the operations that are not gestures -- object filling and relabeling, swapping object and background, size filtering and Otsu detection, with undo and redo over all of them -- alongside the brush, wand and display controls, and can be hidden to return its width to the canvas.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#8
records.source: Editor modes are assembled from :func:`tool_row_entries` and :data:`TOOL_MODES`. :meth:`MakeMasksScreen.add_toolbar_action` inserts non-mode actions into the same toolbar. The settings panel carries the operations that are not gestures -- object filling and relabeling, swapping object and background, size filtering and Otsu detection, with undo and redo over all of them -- alongside the brush, wand and display controls, and can be hidden to return its width to the canvas.
records.translation: Ritilshamarnir eru settir saman úr :func:`tool_row_entries` og :data:`TOOL_MODES`. :meth:`MakeMasksScreen.add_toolbar_action` bætir aðgerðum sem eru ekki hamir við sömu verkfærastiku. Stillingaspjaldið geymir aðgerðir sem eru ekki músarhreyfingar —fyllingu og endurmerkingu hluta, skipti á hlut og bakgrunni, stærðarsíun og Otsu-greiningu, allt með afturköllun og endurtekningu— ásamt stýringum fyrir pensil, sprota og birtingu. Hægt er að fela það til að skila breidd þess til myndflatarins.

records.context: Image inversion and swapping object and background are separate operations. The first changes the image seen by the detector; the second changes labels.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#9
records.source: Image inversion and swapping object and background are separate operations. The first changes the image seen by the detector; the second changes labels.
records.translation: Viðsnúningur myndar og skipti á hlut og bakgrunni eru aðskildar aðgerðir. Sú fyrri breytir myndinni sem greinirinn sér; sú síðari breytir merkingum.

records.context: **Invert image**, in the Display category, is THE inversion. It draws the microscope field of view as its own negative and hands the detectors that same negative: both detect buttons and the live magnifier segment :meth:`MakeMasksScreen._detector_image`, so a threshold written for bright objects takes dark ones, and a banner above the image says so for as long as it is on. The corner readout's pixel intensity follows the inverted image. Object mean intensities and the object filter still read the loaded pixels. Saving writes label masks without changing the source image.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#10
records.source: **Invert image**, in the Display category, is THE inversion. It draws the field as its own negative and hands the detectors that same negative: both detect buttons and the live magnifier segment :meth:`MakeMasksScreen._detector_image`, so a threshold written for bright objects takes dark ones, and a banner above the image says so for as long as it is on. The corner readout's pixel intensity follows the inverted image. Object mean intensities and the object filter still read the loaded pixels. Saving writes label masks without changing the source image.
records.translation: **Snúa mynd við**, í flokknum Birting, er sameiginlegi viðsnúningurinn. Hann teiknar myndsviðið sem neikvæða mynd og gefur greinunum sömu neikvæðu mynd: báðir greiningarhnapparnir og lifandi stækkunarglerið hluta :meth:`MakeMasksScreen._detector_image`, svo þröskuldur fyrir bjarta hluti finnur dökka. Borði fyrir ofan myndina sýnir þetta meðan virknin er á. Styrkleiki myndpunkts í horninu fylgir viðsnúnu myndinni. Meðalstyrkleiki hluta og hlutasían lesa áfram hlaðna myndpunkta. Við vistun eru merkingagrímur skrifaðar án þess að breyta upprunalegu myndinni.

records.context: It used to be two switches and they could disagree. A display-only "Invert image" drew a negative and left detection untouched; "Invert for detection" inverted what the detectors read and drew nothing. A curator could hold either without the other, and the first one's status line had to contradict the second one's banner. They are one switch because the reason for the switch is one intention: inverting a microscope field of view of dark objects so that Otsu and the magnifier can detect them. ``_cp_invert`` is now the same widget object as ``_invert_display`` under its old name, so the two cannot come apart.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#11
records.source: IT USED TO BE TWO SWITCHES AND THEY COULD DISAGREE. A display-only "Invert image" drew a negative and left detection untouched; "Invert for detection" inverted what the detectors read and drew nothing. A curator could hold either without the other, and the first one's status line had to contradict the second one's banner. They are one switch because the reason for the switch is one intention: inverting a field of dark objects so that Otsu and the magnifier can detect them. ``_cp_invert`` is now the same widget object as ``_invert_display`` under its old name, so the two cannot come apart.
records.translation: ÁÐUR VORU TVEIR ROFAR SEM GÁTU STANGAST Á. "Invert image" (Snúa mynd við), sem hafði aðeins áhrif á birtingu, teiknaði neikvæða mynd án þess að breyta greiningu; "Invert for detection" (Snúa við fyrir greiningu) sneri við því sem greinarnir lásu án þess að teikna neitt. Hægt var að hafa annan á án hins og stöðulína þess fyrri gat stangast á við borða þess síðari. Nú er einn rofi því tilgangurinn er einn: að snúa við myndsviði með dökkum hlutum svo Otsu og stækkunarglerið geti greint þá. ``_cp_invert`` er nú sami viðmótshlutur og ``_invert_display`` undir gamla heitinu og því geta þau ekki lengur verið ósamstillt.

records.context: **Swap object and background**, in Object operations, is the old "Invert mask" under the name that describes it -- it flips the LABEL image, which on an ordinary microscope field of view leaves one object covering the frame. It is not a picture invert and is deliberately not called one.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#12
records.source: **Swap object and background**, in Object operations, is the old "Invert mask" under the name that describes it -- it flips the LABEL image, which on an ordinary field leaves one object covering the frame. It is not a picture invert and is deliberately not called one.
records.translation: **Skipta á hlut og bakgrunni**, undir Aðgerðir á hlutum, er gamla "Invert mask" (Snúa grímu við) undir lýsandi heiti: það snýr við MERKINGAMYNDINNI og á venjulegu myndsviði verður þá einn hlutur sem þekur allan rammann. Þetta er ekki viðsnúningur myndar og er vísvitandi ekki kallað það.

records.context: The arithmetic. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_normalized` normalises the microscope field of view to 0..1 on its own range and takes ``1 - v``, and the normalisation is not incidental: the Otsu correction is a MULTIPLIER on an absolute level, so normalising first is what makes one correction value mean the same thing on the next image. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_intensity` (dtype complement) and :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_for_detection` (reflection about the microscope field of view's range) are what this application view used before and are kept for other callers. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_mask` flips labels.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#13
records.source: THE ARITHMETIC. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_normalized` normalises the field to 0..1 on its own range and takes ``1 - v``, and the normalisation is not incidental: the Otsu correction is a MULTIPLIER on an absolute level, so normalising first is what makes one correction value mean the same thing on the next image. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_intensity` (dtype complement) and :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_for_detection` (reflection about the field's range) are what this screen used before and are kept for other callers. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_mask` flips labels.
records.translation: ÚTREIKNINGURINN. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_normalized` kvarðar myndsviðið á 0..1 miðað við eigið gildisbil og reiknar ``1 - v``. Kvörðunin skiptir máli: Otsu-leiðréttingin er MARGFALDARI á algildum þröskuldi, þannig að kvörðun fyrst gerir það að verkum að sama leiðréttingargildi hefur sömu merkingu á næstu mynd. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_intensity` (fylling gagnagerðar) og :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_for_detection` (speglun um gildisbil myndsviðsins) voru áður notuð á þessum skjá og eru varðveitt fyrir aðra kallendur. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_mask` snýr við merkingum.
